Looking at the gov tables for temporal binding info, but the Player_Attributes table only has a single `date` column. Let me provide a cleaner query that gets the latest attribute per player as-of 2013-12-25:

```sql
SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
FROM (
  SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.overall_rating,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id ORDER BY CAST(pa.date AS DATE) DESC) AS rn
  FROM main."Player_Attributes" pa
  WHERE CAST(pa.date AS DATE) <= '2013-12-25'
) t
WHERE rn = 1;
```
